scope: Three agent source-inspected English navigation labels only; no human review or whole-page review.

reviews.trigger: open the English privacy page; activate Search & commands
reviews.rationale: Plain visible button label opens the existing command palette; no legal text, book content or technical payload is admitted.

reviews.trigger: open the English privacy page; follow its library navigation
reviews.rationale: Visible header link names the destination and preserves its arrow; only the link label enters lint, never its URL or legal paragraphs.

reviews.trigger: reach the end of the English privacy notice; return to library
reviews.rationale: Visible return action after the notice is ordinary navigation copy; the notice body and contact/source data remain unknown candidates.
